record.paper: Induced subgraphs of bounded treewidth and the container method

dossier_meta.paper: Induced subgraphs of bounded treewidth and the container method
dossier_meta.statement_text: Determine the computational complexity of the Maximum Weight Independent Set problem in $P_7$-free graphs.
dossier_meta.context_text: Polynomial-time algorithms for MWIS in $P_5$-free graphs (2014) and $P_6$-free graphs (2019) were previously known. This paper extends tractability to the class $\mathcal{C}$ (which contains all $P_5$-free graphs), but the authors note that the case of $P_7$-free graphs remains open.
